Dear [Customer],

Thank you for reaching out to us about your second refund request. I understand that you accidentally renewed your subscription and would like a refund.

However, based on our Refund Policy, I need to inform you that refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of billing. Since your initial refund request was approved last month and you've now submitted a second request, I'm afraid this falls outside of our refund eligibility window.

I'd like to offer you assistance with cancelling your subscription instead. You can do this by going to Account Settings → Billing → Cancel Subscription. This will ensure that your subscription ends at the end of the current billing period and you won't be charged again.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'm here to help.
